section.content: The invention provides a lithium ion battery. The lithium ion battery includes: a positive electrode plate; a negative pole piece; the isolating film is spaced between the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece; and an electrolyte. The positive electrode diaphragm also comprises a positive electrode additive; the positive electrode additive is lithium carbonate; the electrolyte also comprises an electrolyte additive; the electrolyte additive comprises flavonoid compounds, and the chemical formula is as follows:wherein, H at the 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 1 ', 2 ', 3 ', 4 ' and 5 ' positions is independently substituted by the above functional group substituted by phenolic hydroxyl, alkyl, alkoxy, carboxyl, amino, aryl or halogen. The lithium ion battery effectively solves the problem of thermal failure of the lithium ion battery caused by the side reaction of the lithium carbonate in the positive pole piece under the high-temperature condition, and meanwhile, the lithium ion battery has better overcharge resistance.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical field

The present invention relates to battery technology field more particularly to a kind of lithium ion batteries.

Background technology

Continue charging after lithium ion battery completely fills when there is overcharge, the positive and negative anodes of lithium ion battery can all be in one kind The state of " excess load ", therefore will produce a series of side reaction.At anode, current potential increases non-in easily oxidation electrolyte Aqueous organic solvent, and the heat that non-aqueous organic solvent oxidation reaction is discharged caused by overcharge is significantly larger than normal charge and discharge The heat that oxidation reaction is discharged occurs for non-aqueous organic solvent in the case of electricity；At cathode, the insertion reaction of lithium ion can continue It carries out, lithium ion is caused to be easy that deposition reaction occurs in negative terminal surface.These abnormal responses can all make the performance of lithium ion battery The problems such as deteriorating rapidly, large area diffusion, the internal short-circuit of battery of heat can occur when more serious, increases lithium ion battery and rises Hot fried possibility.

In order to avoid the variety of problems that overcharge is brought, at present common practice in the art be lithium ion battery just A small amount of lithium carbonate is added in the diaphragm of pole.When overcharge occurs for lithium ion battery, voltage rises rapidly, when voltage is higher than 4.7V Lithium carbonate will react with the proton hydrogen in lithium ion battery, discharge rapidly carbon dioxide gas, therewith inside battery gas Pressure, which steeply rises, destroys the shell of lithium ion battery, washes safety valve open, cuts off charging current, lithium ion battery is avoided to occur Hot fried equal thermal failures behavior.

Inventor, although the addition of lithium carbonate can play good gas-forming reaction, works as lithium by testing discovery repeatedly When ion battery is in the condition of high temperature, the oxidation product of positive electrode active materials oxygen release and electrolyte reacts with lithium carbonate again, Accelerate lithium ion battery self-heat generation, eventually lead to lithium ion battery occur it is on fire explosion etc. thermal failures behavior, therefore fail from Fundamentally solve the safety problem of lithium ion battery.

Invention content

The problem of in view of background technology, the purpose of the present invention is to provide a kind of lithium ion battery, the lithium from Sub- battery, which efficiently solves the generation side reaction of the lithium carbonate in anode pole piece under the high temperature conditions, leads to lithium ion battery thermal failure The problem of, while lithium ion battery has preferable overcharge resistance performance energy.

To achieve the goals above, the present invention provides a kind of lithium ion batteries, including：Anode pole piece, including anode collection Fluid and the positive diaphragm for being set on plus plate current-collecting body and include positive electrode active materials, conductive agent and binder；Cathode pole Piece, including negative current collector and be set on negative current collector and include the negative of negative electrode active material, conductive agent and binder Pole diaphragm；Isolation film is interval between anode pole piece and cathode pole piece；And electrolyte, including lithium salts and non-aqueous organic solvent. Positive diaphragm further includes anode additive；Anode additive is lithium carbonate；Electrolyte further includes electrolysis additive；Electrolyte adds It includes flavone compound to add agent, and chemical formula is as follows：

Wherein, the H on 3,5,6,7,8,1 ', 2 ', 3 ', 4 ' and 5 ' positions each independently by phenolic hydroxyl group, hydroxyl, alkyl, Alkoxy, carboxyl, amino, aromatic radical or the above-mentioned functional group of halogen substitution are replaced.

Compared with the existing technology, beneficial effects of the present invention are as follows：

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the addition of anode additive lithium carbonate makes lithium ion battery overcharge condition Under can a large amount of aerogenesis, the shell of lithium ion battery is destroyed, washes safety valve open, charging current is cut off, to ensure lithium ion Battery has preferable overcharge resistance performance energy.Meanwhile the flavone compound in electrolyte can effectively absorb under the high temperature conditions The oxygen radical of positive electrode active materials oxygen release abjection prevents oxygen radical to a series of side reactions such as the oxidation of electrolyte, reduces The by-product of the oxidation reaction of oxygen radical and electrolyte and lithium carbonate react the thermal discharge of generation, efficiently solve in height The problem of side reaction leads to lithium ion battery thermal failure occurs for the lithium carbonate under the conditions of temperature in anode pole piece, improves lithium ion battery Security performance.

Specific implementation mode

Illustrate lithium ion battery according to the present invention and embodiment, comparative example and test process and test knot below Fruit.

Illustrate lithium ion battery according to the present invention first.

Lithium ion battery according to the present invention, including：Anode pole piece, including plus plate current-collecting body and it is set to plus plate current-collecting body Positive diaphragm that is upper and including positive electrode active materials, conductive agent and binder；Cathode pole piece, including negative current collector and setting In on negative current collector and include negative electrode active material, conductive agent and binder cathode membrane；Isolation film is interval in anode Between pole piece and cathode pole piece；And electrolyte, including lithium salts and non-aqueous organic solvent.Positive diaphragm further includes positive addition Agent；Anode additive is lithium carbonate；Electrolyte further includes electrolysis additive；Electrolysis additive includes flavone compound, Chemical formula is as follows：

Wherein, the H on 3,5,6,7,8,1 ', 2 ', 3 ', 4 ' and 5 ' positions each independently by phenolic hydroxyl group, hydroxyl, alkyl, Alkoxy, carboxyl, amino, aromatic radical or the above-mentioned functional group of halogen substitution are replaced.

In lithium ion battery according to the present invention, flavone compound can be selected from Quercetin, rutin, Nobiletin And one kind in Kaempferol, but not limited to this, as long as the chemical formula structure with above-mentioned flavone compound.

In lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the addition of lithium carbonate can be the quality hundred of positive electrode active materials Divide the 0.5%~5% of ratio.The addition of lithium carbonate is excessively high, correspondingly, quality percentage of the positive electrode active materials in positive diaphragm Than opposite reduction, then the energy density of lithium ion battery can reduce, and deteriorate to hot tank serious, and thermal failure temperature reduces, lithium from The overcharging resisting degradation of sub- battery；The addition of lithium carbonate is too low, and gas production is not enough to wash safety valve, cut-out charging open very little Electric current, and then can not ensure the overcharge resistance performance energy of lithium ion battery.

In lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the addition of flavone compound can be the quality hundred of electrolyte Divide the 0.002%~0.1% of ratio.The addition of flavone compound is too low, then it is weaker to the absorption of oxygen radical, is not enough to It makes up lithium carbonate and the problem of side reaction leads to lithium ion battery thermal failure occurs；The molecular weight of flavone compound is larger, in electricity The solubility solved in liquid is smaller, if addition is excessive, cannot be completely dissolved in the electrolytic solution, and then excessive flavonoids Closing object can cause lithium ion battery liquid injection difficult.

In lithium ion battery according to the present invention, positive electrode active materials can be selected from LiCoO2、LiMn2O4、LiNi1/3Co1/3Mn1/3And Li (CoxNiyMn1-x-y)O2One or more of, wherein 0.3≤x≤0.8,0.1≤y≤0.4,0.6 ≤x+y≤0.9。

In lithium ion battery according to the present invention, negative electrode active material can be selected from graphite and/or silicon.

In lithium ion battery according to the present invention, lithium salts can be selected from LiTFSI, LiFSI, LiN (CxF2x+1SO2) (CyF2y+1SO2)、LiPF6、LiBF4、LiBOB、LiAsF6、LiCF3SO3And LiClO4One or more of, wherein x, y are Natural number.

In lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the concentration of lithium salts can be 0.8M~1.5M.

In lithium ion battery according to the present invention, non-aqueous organic solvent can be selected from ethylene carbonate (EC), carbonic acid One or more of acrylic ester (PC), dimethyl carbonate (DMC), diethyl carbonate (DEC) and methyl ethyl carbonate (EMC).

In lithium ion battery according to the present invention, isolation film can be selected from polyolefin film and polyolefin/ceramics apply One or more of layer composite membrane.

The embodiment and comparative example of lithium ion battery according to the present invention will be illustrated next.

Embodiment 1

(1) preparation of anode pole piece：By positive electrode active materials lithium nickel cobalt manganese LiNi1/3Co1/3Mn1/3, anode additive carbonic acid Lithium, conductive agent Super P and binder polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) in mass ratio 95.06:1.94:1.4:1.6 and solvent Anode sizing agent is made in N-Methyl pyrrolidone (NMP) mixing, later by anode sizing agent be uniformly coated in current collector aluminum foil and It is cold-pressed after being dried at 85 DEG C, after then carrying out trimming, cut-parts, slitting, then 4h is dried under 85 DEG C of vacuum condition, welded Lug completes the preparation of anode pole piece.

(2) preparation of cathode pole piece：By negative electrode active material graphite, conductive agent Super P, thickener CMC and bonding Agent SBR in mass ratio 97:1:1:1 is made negative electrode slurry with solvent deionized water mixing, is later uniformly coated on negative electrode slurry It is cold-pressed after being dried on copper foil of affluxion body and at 85 DEG C, after then carrying out trimming, cut-parts, slitting, then in 110 DEG C of vacuum items 4h is dried under part, soldering polar ear completes the preparation of cathode pole piece.

(3) preparation of electrolyte：Electrolyte is with the LiPF of a concentration of 1mol/L6For lithium salts, with ethylene carbonate (EC), carbon The mixture of sour methyl ethyl ester (EMC) and diethyl carbonate (DEC) is non-aqueous organic solvent, and the mass ratio of EC, EMC, DMC are 30: 50:20.In addition, being also added into the electrolysis additive Quercetin that mass percentage is 0.005% in electrolyte.

(4) preparation of lithium ion battery：Using polypropylene film as isolation film, by anode pole piece obtained, isolation film, bear Pole pole piece is folded in order, and isolation film is made to be among positive and negative anodes pole piece, and winding obtains naked battery core；Naked battery core is placed in outside battery In packaging, electrolyte, encapsulation, standing, chemical conversion, shaping, volume test are injected later, completes the preparation of lithium ion battery, wherein The thickness of lithium ion battery is 4.2mm, width 32mm, length 82mm.

Finally provide the security performance test process and test knot of the lithium ion battery of embodiment 1-9 and comparative example 1-7 Fruit.

(1) lithium ion battery overcharges the test of aerogenesis volume：At 25 DEG C, first lithium ion battery is filled with the constant current of 1C Electricity is further less than 0.05C with 4.2V constant-potential charges to electric current, is then discharged to lithium ion battery with 0.5C to 4.2V 3.0V, carries out fully charged state volume test later, and the volume of lithium ion battery is denoted as V1；Again with the constant current of 1C by lithium ion Battery charges to 170% overcharging state, and carries out overcharging state volume test, and the volume of lithium ion battery is denoted as V2。

Cubical expansivity (%)=[(V of lithium ion battery2-V1)/V1] × 100%.

(2) lithium ion battery hot tank is tested：At 25 DEG C, 4.2V is charged to lithium ion battery with the constant current of 1C, It is further 0.05C with 4.2V constant-potential charges to electric current.Lithium ion battery is disassembled, anode pole piece is individually taken out and weighs it After spool doubling again be put into battery pack pack in；The electrolyte of corresponding amount is added, guarantee electrolyte ownership is 3g；Vacuumizing will Battery pack pack sealing forms battery core, places 6h or more, ensures that anode pole piece can fully infiltrate electrolyte；Battery core is put into later In safe hot tank, 230 DEG C are raised to by 25 DEG C with the speed of 2 DEG C/min, keeps the temperature 30min, monitoring battery core surface temperature variation.Its In, battery core temperature when starting to steeply rise corresponding furnace temperature be battery core hot tank invalid temperature.

Fig. 1 shows the hot tank test result of comparative example 1-3, by the test result of Fig. 1 and comparative example 1-3 it is found that just Lithium carbonate is only added in the pole piece of pole can make lithium ion battery have good gas generation property, but its hot tank brought deteriorates Also fairly obvious, anode pole piece becomes strong to the sensibility of heat, and thermal failure temperature reduces.By comparative example 2, comparative example 5, embodiment 1 Comparison with embodiment 6 is it is found that the addition of Quercetin can effectively make up caused by the addition of lithium carbonate under the high temperature conditions Anode pole piece issue of ASIC thermal failure, and with the increase of Quercetin addition, it is brighter to the improvement of anode pole piece issue of ASIC thermal failure Aobvious, the hot tank invalid temperature of lithium ion battery increases and the gas production of lithium ion battery is not also decreased obviously.But Quercetin Addition it is too low, then it is weaker to the absorption of oxygen radical, and being not enough to make up lithium carbonate side reaction occurs leads to lithium-ion electric The problem of pond thermal failure.

By the comparison of embodiment 1 and embodiment 7-9 it is found that addition rutin, Kaempferol and Nobiletin are same in the electrolytic solution Sample has good improvement result to anode pole piece issue of ASIC thermal failure.This is primarily due to Quercetin, rutin, Kaempferol and river dried orange peel Element all has identical flavones structure, and has reaction mechanism shown in Fig. 2：Oxygen radical (is taken off by positive electrode active materials oxygen release Go out) No. 3 position carbon atoms formation C=O bonds are cast the first stone, and cause a series of oxygen radical and absorb decarburizing reaction, effectively inhale The oxygen radical for receiving positive electrode active materials oxygen release abjection under the high temperature conditions, prevents oxygen radical to a system such as oxidation of electrolyte Row side reaction reduces the by-product of the oxidation reaction of oxygen radical and electrolyte and lithium carbonate and reacts the thermal discharge of generation, Postpone hot tank invalid temperature, improves the security performance of lithium ion battery.
